run_3d_object_detection: run 3D object detection on images in a folder using CubeRCNN with a config file and threshold
run_detection_with_display: run 3D object detection on images and display results with matplotlib using the display flag
run_detection_custom_camera: run 3D object detection with custom focal length and principal point camera parameters
run_detection_multi_gpu: run 3D object detection across multiple GPUs using distributed training with num-gpus and num-machines
run_detection_custom_threshold: run 3D object detection with a custom confidence threshold for filtering detections
